meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: What the Collège Tomi Fidele website does with your data: no visitor accounts, no advertising trackers, requests read only by the school office and erased after 12 months, a map loaded on request.

hero.title: Your data and {this site}
hero.intro: This site introduces the school. It does not create visitor accounts and sets no advertising trackers. Requests sent through its forms are read only by the school office.

items.title: No account, no tracking
items.text: You browse the site without identifying yourself. It uses neither advertising cookies nor analytics tools.

items.title: Requests read by the school office
items.text: Pre-registrations and contact messages go to the school office, and to it alone. They are erased after 12 months.

items.title: A map on request
items.text: The Google Maps map only loads if you tap "Show the map".

sections.title: Who is responsible for this site?
paragraphs: The site is published by Collège Tomi Fidele. [Name and role of the person responsible for publication, to be provided.]
For any question about your data: [school office email or phone number, to be provided].

sections.title: Pre-registration and contact form
paragraphs: When you send a pre-registration or a message, your answers are stored in the school's password-protected management area. Only the school office, the principal and the site's technical administrator can read them.
They are used only to handle your request: calling you back, preparing an enrolment file, answering a question. They are never sold or passed on to other organisations.
Nothing is sent unless you tick the consent box. You can also let the school office know on WhatsApp: that message follows WhatsApp's own rules.
To limit abuse, the site keeps, for 24 hours, a fingerprint of the device used, computed from its address without storing that address in plain form.
points: Data concerned: the student's name, the class requested, the parent's name and phone number, your message.
Recipients: the school office and the principal.
Retention period: 12 months after sending, then automatic erasure.
Storage: Supabase database, on servers located in Paris (France).

sections.title: What the site keeps on your device
paragraphs: The site remembers two things in your browser for the duration of your visit: that you closed the announcement bar, and that the welcome screen has already been shown.
Neither contains any personal information. Both are erased when you close the tab.

sections.title: The map and external links
paragraphs: If you display the map, it is provided by Google Maps: Google then receives your IP address and may set its own cookies. Until you ask for it, nothing is exchanged with Google.
The WhatsApp, Facebook and Google Calendar buttons and the links to the school's social networks open external services, which apply their own privacy rules.
Sharing a news item or a date only passes on the link you choose to send.

sections.title: Hosting and technical logs
paragraphs: Like any website, this one is served by a hosting provider, which keeps technical logs (IP address, date, page requested) to keep the service secure and running. The school does not use them to identify visitors.
Website host: Netlify. Request database: Supabase (servers in Paris). [Providers' legal addresses, to be confirmed at launch.]

sections.title: Photos of students
paragraphs: The photos published on the site show school life. [School rule to be specified: parents' consent collected at enrolment, no name attached to a student's photo.]
A parent can ask for a photo of their child to be removed by writing to the school office.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask to see, correct or delete the information you have given the school, and object to its use.
Simply write to or call in at the school office. The school will reply as soon as possible.

cta.title: Any questions about your {data}?
cta.text: The school office answers by phone, on WhatsApp or in person.
